paragraphs: Saskatchewan Polytechnic is a public polytechnic institution with campuses across Saskatchewan, Canada, offering certificate and diploma programs in business, technology, health, construction, and agriculture. Founded as a network of institutes of applied arts and science, Sask Polytech serves over 26,000 students annually.

Saskatchewan Polytechnic is closely connected to Saskatchewan's key industries — agriculture, mining, oil and gas, and healthcare — providing graduates with strong employment prospects in Western Canada. Programs in practical nursing, agriculture, engineering technology, and IT are particularly popular with international students.

Saskatchewan offers one of Canada's lowest costs of living and most accessible immigration pathways through the Saskatchewan Immigrant Nominee Program. International students benefit from a welcoming, safe prairie city environment with a strong sense of community.

Graduates from eligible programs qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and may access Saskatchewan and federal immigration programs. The province actively recruits skilled workers and graduates in healthcare, trades, and agriculture.
paragraphsRu: Saskatchewan Polytechnic — государственный политехнический институт с кампусами по всей провинции Саскачеван. Ежегодно обслуживает более 26 000 студентов.
Sask Polytech тесно связан с ключевыми отраслями Саскачевана — сельским хозяйством, горным делом, нефтью и газом, здравоохранением.
Саскачеван предлагает одну из самых низких стоимостей жизни в Канаде и доступные иммиграционные пути через Saskatchewan Immigrant Nominee Program.
Выпускники соответствующих программ получают право на Post-Graduation Work Permit.
